students.title: Students

delete.title: Delete this student?
delete.body: {name} will be removed from the registry. This cannot be undone.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Academy teams with mentor, target competition and roster. An active team can be turned into an application; selection stays a human decision.

stats.readyHint: Active, competition, captain and no open application
stats.appliedHint: Submitted, under review, accepted or waitlisted
